news.titleEn: Markets see Warsh endorsing a rate hike in September. Not everyone is convinced
news.conclusionEn: After Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole speech, fed funds futures now price roughly a 60% chance of a quarter-point rate hike at the September 16-17 meeting, up from about 30% a week earlier.
news.conclusionZh: 沃什鹰派讲话后，市场对9月加息25个基点的押注升至约60%
news.whyEn: It would be the first Fed rate increase of this cycle, raising borrowing costs on mortgages, corporate debt and government financing, and deepening the public rift between Warsh and President Trump, who wants lower rates.
news.whyZh: 这将是本轮首次加息，推高房贷与企业融资成本，并加深沃什与主张降息的特朗普之间的公开分歧。
news.detailEn: Warsh told the Jackson Hole symposium that better summer inflation prints do not show underlying trends have 'meaningfully improved,' with headline PCE at 3.7% and core at 3.3%. Three of 12 voting members already favored a hike in July, when the decision to hold passed 9-3, so only a few more votes would flip the balance. Some economists remain skeptical a hike is locked in, pointing to a softening labor market and Friday's August jobs report as the key swing factor. Treasury yields and the dollar firmed after the speech, while rate-sensitive equities sold off and gold held near record levels around 4,450 dollars an ounce.
news.detailZh: 沃什在杰克逊霍尔年会上表示，夏季通胀数据虽有好转，但未显示底层趋势「实质性改善」，整体PCE通胀为3.7%、核心为3.3%。7月议息时，12名有投票权的委员中已有3人主张加息，当时维持利率的决定以9比3通过，只需再多几票即可翻盘。部分经济学家仍怀疑加息是否已成定局，指出劳动力市场走软、周五公布的8月非农就业报告才是关键变量。讲话后美债收益率与美元走强，利率敏感型股票承压，金价维持在每盎司约4450美元的历史高位附近。

news.titleEn: U.S. forces strike Iranian rocket launchers on the Strait of Hormuz in first military action in weeks
news.conclusionEn: U.S. Central Command said its forces destroyed Iranian Revolutionary Guard rocket launchers near Larak Island on Sunday that were preparing to fire sea mines into the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran said it responded by launching missiles at two U.S. bases in Jordan.
news.conclusionZh: 美军周日空袭霍尔木兹海峡伊朗火箭发射器，伊朗称已向约旦两处美军基地还击
news.whyEn: About a fifth of the world's seaborne oil normally passes through the strait, so renewed fighting after weeks of calm revives the risk of a supply shock and a wider regional escalation.
news.whyZh: 全球约五分之一的海运石油通常经此海峡，平静数周后重燃战火，再度推高供应冲击与地区扩大化的风险。
news.detailEn: The strike was the first known U.S. military action against Iran in about a month, after the Trump administration had said it would shift toward economic pressure rather than force. Iran's Revolutionary Guard acknowledged that fighters and civilians were killed or wounded without giving a toll, and vowed retaliation. Iranian state media reported missile launches at the King Hussein and Muwaffaq Salti air bases in Jordan, and Trump warned the U.S. would 'hit them hard.' The conflict over Hormuz has run intermittently since early 2026 and has cut shipping through the waterway to well below normal levels.
news.detailZh: 这是美军约一个月来首次对伊朗采取军事行动，此前特朗普政府曾表示将转向经济施压而非动武。伊朗革命卫队承认有武装人员和平民伤亡，但未公布具体数字，并誓言报复。伊朗官方媒体称已向约旦的侯赛因国王空军基地和穆瓦法克·萨勒提空军基地发射导弹，特朗普警告美方将「狠狠打击」伊朗。围绕霍尔木兹海峡的冲突自2026年初以来时断时续，已使该航道通行量远低于正常水平。

news.titleEn: Latest oil market news and analysis for Aug. 31
news.conclusionEn: Oil jumped as trading resumed, with Brent for November rising back above 90 dollars a barrel and West Texas Intermediate near 86 dollars, after the U.S. strike on Iranian rocket launchers near the Strait of Hormuz.
news.conclusionZh: 美军空袭后油价开盘跳涨，布伦特原油重回90美元上方，WTI逼近86美元
news.whyEn: Higher crude feeds straight into headline inflation just as central banks weigh rate moves, and squeezes transport-heavy businesses and consumers.
news.whyZh: 油价上涨直接推高整体通胀，正值央行权衡利率走向，也挤压运输密集型企业与消费者。
news.detailEn: Roughly 6 million to 8 million barrels of crude still transit Hormuz each day, sharply down from pre-conflict levels, and traders are watching whether Iran follows through on threats to disrupt tanker traffic further. Even before the strike, crude was heading for its strongest month since March on a Middle East risk premium, though gains were capped by softer demand forecasts from OPEC and the IEA and weak data from China. OPEC+ has agreed to a final tranche of supply increases for September, completing the unwind of its 2023 voluntary cuts, but will pause further hikes in the fourth quarter. A sustained rise in energy prices would raise the stakes for the Fed's September meeting.
news.detailZh: 目前每天仍有约600万至800万桶原油通过霍尔木兹海峡，远低于冲突前水平，交易员正关注伊朗是否兑现进一步扰乱油轮通行的威胁。在空袭之前，受中东风险溢价支撑，原油已有望创下3月以来最强月度表现，但涨幅受到OPEC与IEA下调需求预期、以及中国数据疲软的抑制。OPEC+已同意9月最后一批增产，完成对2023年自愿减产的退出，但将在第四季度暂停进一步增产。能源价格若持续上涨，将加大美联储9月议息的分量。

news.conclusionEn: U.S. stocks slipped Monday but still closed out a fifth straight monthly gain, with the S&P 500 up about 2.6% in August, the Nasdaq Composite up about 3.9% and the Dow up about 1.3%, as investors braced for a heavy data week.
news.conclusionZh: 美股周一小幅回落，但8月收涨，标普500涨约2.6%，为连续第五个月上涨
news.whyEn: September is historically the weakest month for equities, and this year it arrives alongside a possible Fed rate hike, the August jobs report and marquee tech earnings, leaving the rally exposed.
news.whyZh: 9月历来是美股最弱的月份，今年又叠加可能的加息、非农就业报告和科技巨头财报，涨势面临考验。
news.detailEn: Manufacturing and services surveys are due Tuesday and Wednesday, followed by the August employment report on Friday, which economists expect to show only tens of thousands of jobs added and unemployment around 4.1%. Chip designer Broadcom reports on Sept. 2, one of several large technology earnings that could set the tone for AI-linked stocks. Markets have also been digesting Fed Chair Warsh's hawkish Jackson Hole message and firmer Treasury yields. Traders see the combination of stretched valuations and event risk as a recipe for near-term volatility.
news.detailZh: 周二和周三将公布制造业与服务业调查，周五公布8月就业报告，经济学家预计新增就业仅数万人、失业率约4.1%。芯片设计商博通将于9月2日发布财报，是可能为AI相关股票定调的多家科技巨头之一。市场同时在消化美联储主席沃什偏鹰的杰克逊霍尔表态以及走高的美债收益率。交易员认为，估值偏高叠加事件风险，是短期波动加剧的诱因。

news.titleEn: The U.S.-Venezuela oil deal won't lower your gas prices. Here's what you need to know
news.conclusionEn: President Trump announced a deal under which a new U.S.-linked private company would gain long-term rights to develop 17 strategic Venezuelan oil fields holding more than 65 billion barrels of reserves, with the U.S. side taking a majority economic interest.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普宣布协议，美方关联新公司将获委内瑞拉17个战略油田长期开发权并占多数权益
news.whyEn: It would roughly double the oil reserves under U.S. control and deepen Washington's grip on Venezuela following the January operation that captured former president Maduro, but analysts say it will take years to lift output and will not quickly move pump prices.
news.whyZh: 此举将使美国控制的石油储量约翻倍，并加深对委内瑞拉的掌控，但分析人士称增产需数年、难以迅速拉低油价。
news.detailEn: The agreement, negotiated by Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth with acting Venezuelan President Delcy Rodriguez, grants the new entity 100-year development rights and gives the U.S. side roughly 55% of output plus the right to buy crude at cost. Venezuela's fields need heavy investment and specialized refining, and the country's production has been depressed for years by sanctions and underinvestment. Critics question the legality and the precedent of taking control of another state's resources. The deal drew coverage from NBC News, NPR, CNBC and Al Jazeera and is likely to face legal and diplomatic challenges.
news.detailZh: 该协议由美国国务卿鲁比奥和国防部长赫格塞思与委内瑞拉代理总统德尔西·罗德里格斯谈成，授予新实体100年开发权，美方获约55%的产量并可按成本价购油。委内瑞拉油田需要大量投资和专门的炼化能力，该国产量多年来因制裁和投资不足而低迷。批评者质疑控制他国资源的合法性及其开创的先例。该消息获NBC、NPR、CNBC和半岛电视台报道，预计将面临法律和外交挑战。

news.titleEn: Tim Cook to become Apple Executive Chairman; John Ternus to become Apple CEO
news.conclusionEn: Apple's leadership handover takes effect Tuesday, Sept. 1, with hardware engineering chief John Ternus becoming CEO after 15 years of Tim Cook, who moves to executive chairman.
news.conclusionZh: 苹果9月1日完成权力交接，硬件工程主管特纳斯接任CEO，库克转任执行董事长
news.whyEn: Apple is one of the world's most valuable companies, and the change puts a product-and-engineering leader in charge just before a major fall product cycle and amid backlash over recent price increases.
news.whyZh: 苹果是全球市值最高的公司之一，此次交接让工程与产品出身的高管在秋季重要产品周期前掌舵，正值涨价争议。
news.detailEn: Ternus joined Apple in 2001 on the product design team and became senior vice president of hardware engineering in 2021, overseeing iPhone, iPad and Mac hardware. Cook, as executive chairman, will focus on Apple's board, its relationships with governments including the U.S. and China, and long-term strategy. The transition was announced in April and timed to precede Apple's Sept. 9 product event, expected to feature new iPhones. Investors will watch whether Ternus adjusts Apple's services pricing, AI roadmap and capital returns.
news.detailZh: 特纳斯2001年加入苹果的产品设计团队，2021年出任硬件工程高级副总裁，负责iPhone、iPad和Mac硬件。库克转任执行董事长后，将专注于董事会事务、与包括美中在内的各国政府的关系以及长期战略。此次交接于4月宣布，时间安排在苹果9月9日产品发布会之前，预计发布会将推出新款iPhone。投资者将关注特纳斯是否会调整苹果的服务定价、AI路线图和股东回报。

news.titleEn: Broadcom's Next Earnings Report on September 2 Could Send the Stock Soaring. Here's Why.
news.conclusionEn: Broadcom reports fiscal third-quarter results after the close on Sept. 2, with Wall Street expecting revenue near 29 billion to 30 billion dollars and AI-related semiconductor revenue of roughly 16 billion dollars, more than triple a year earlier.
news.conclusionZh: 博通9月2日盘后发财报，市场预期营收约290–300亿美元，AI芯片收入约160亿美元
news.whyEn: Broadcom is a key gauge of custom AI chip demand from hyperscalers, so its results and backlog commentary move the whole AI hardware complex, from Nvidia to chip-equipment makers.
news.whyZh: 博通是衡量云计算巨头定制AI芯片需求的关键风向标，其业绩与订单指引会牵动整个AI硬件板块。
news.detailEn: Management has guided to about 56 billion dollars of AI semiconductor revenue for fiscal 2026 and has pointed to more than 100 billion dollars of chip-only AI revenue potential in 2027. In the prior quarter, Broadcom posted record revenue of about 22 billion dollars, up roughly 48% year over year, helped by a reported AI order backlog in the tens of billions of dollars. The report lands in the same week as manufacturing data and the August jobs report, and alongside earnings from Dell and Palo Alto Networks. A strong AI number could support richly valued semiconductor stocks, while any hint of slowing orders would raise questions about the durability of the AI capex boom.
news.detailZh: 管理层此前指引2026财年AI半导体收入约560亿美元，并称2027年「仅芯片」的AI收入潜力有望超过1000亿美元。上一季度博通营收约220亿美元创纪录，同比增长约48%，据报道AI订单积压达数百亿美元。这份财报与制造业数据、8月就业报告在同一周公布，同期还有戴尔和Palo Alto Networks的业绩。强劲的AI数据可能支撑估值高企的半导体股，而订单放缓的迹象则会引发对AI资本开支热潮持续性的质疑。

news.titleEn: China's factory activity unexpectedly expands to 51.0 in August amid efforts from Beijing
news.conclusionEn: China's official manufacturing PMI rose to 51.0 in August from 50.9 in July, beating forecasts and moving further into expansion territory as Beijing leans on stimulus for consumption and services.
news.conclusionZh: 中国8月官方制造业PMI升至51.0，好于预期，继续处于扩张区间
news.whyEn: China is the world's second-largest economy and top commodity importer, so signs of stabilizing factory demand affect global growth, exporters and prices for oil and metals.
news.whyZh: 中国是全球第二大经济体和最大商品进口国，工厂需求企稳会影响全球增长、出口商以及油价和金属价格。
news.detailEn: The reading follows a year of uneven recovery, with property still weak and deflationary pressure in producer prices. Policymakers have rolled out consumption subsidies, trade-in programs and support for the services sector, and expanded cross-border yuan operations for multinationals. The private Caixin manufacturing survey, which skews toward smaller and export-focused firms, was due for release around the same time and had been running just above 50. Investors are watching whether momentum can hold into the fourth quarter without a larger fiscal package.
news.detailZh: 此前中国经济复苏并不均衡，房地产依然疲软，工业品出厂价格存在通缩压力。决策层已推出消费补贴、以旧换新计划和服务业支持措施，并扩大了跨国企业的跨境人民币业务。偏向中小和出口型企业的财新制造业调查在同一时间前后发布，此前一直略高于荣枯线50。投资者关注在没有更大规模财政刺激的情况下，这一势头能否延续到第四季度。

news.titleEn: What to Look Out for in Economic Data This Week (August 31-September 4)
news.conclusionEn: The August U.S. employment report lands Friday, Sept. 4, with economists' forecasts clustered between about 25,000 and 80,000 new jobs and unemployment expected to hold near 4.1%, after July's revised decline of 23,000.
news.conclusionZh: 美国8月非农就业报告周五公布，预期新增约2.5万至8万人，失业率约4.1%
news.whyEn: The number is the swing factor for the Fed's September decision: a weak print strengthens the case to hold, while a firm one hands hawks led by Warsh the cover to hike.
news.whyZh: 该数据是美联储9月决策的关键变量：疲软支持按兵不动，强劲则为沃什领衔的鹰派加息提供依据。
news.detailEn: July payrolls unexpectedly fell, and the three-month average has slowed toward the pace needed just to absorb new workers, raising fears the labor market is cracking. Ahead of Friday, markets get ISM manufacturing on Tuesday, JOLTS job openings and ISM services midweek, and ADP's private payrolls estimate. Warsh has said policy should be data-dependent and has kept the September 16-17 meeting 'live.' A downside surprise could quickly reverse the recent rise in rate-hike odds and pull Treasury yields lower.
news.detailZh: 7月非农就业意外下滑，三个月均值已放缓至仅够吸纳新增劳动力的水平，引发对劳动力市场走弱的担忧。周五之前，市场还将迎来周二的ISM制造业指数、周中的JOLTS职位空缺和ISM服务业指数，以及ADP私营部门就业估计。沃什表示政策应依赖数据，并称9月16至17日的会议仍「悬而未决」。若数据大幅不及预期，可能迅速逆转近期升高的加息预期，并压低美债收益率。

news.titleEn: Russian attack on Ukrainian ammunition warehouse triggers waves of blasts, killing 38
news.conclusionEn: A Russian drone attack ignited an ammunition warehouse near Kyiv, setting off hours of secondary explosions in a residential area and killing at least 38 people, in one of the deadliest strikes of the summer.
news.conclusionZh: 俄军无人机袭击基辅附近弹药库，引发数小时连环爆炸，至少38人死亡
news.whyEn: The escalating air war, with Russia launching hundreds of drones and missiles in single barrages, keeps pressure on Western governments over air-defense supplies and sanctions and dims prospects for negotiations.
news.whyZh: 空袭不断升级，俄军单次发动数百架无人机与导弹，令西方在防空供应和制裁上承压，也令谈判前景黯淡。
news.detailEn: Ukrainian officials said more than 260 attack drones were used in the overnight assault, part of a pattern of record-size barrages in August that also killed 17 in Kyiv on Aug. 20. Ukraine has responded with long-range strikes on Russian refineries and military sites, including drone attacks reaching toward Moscow. Air defenses intercept most incoming weapons, but the sheer volume means more get through, and rebuilding stocks of interceptors has become a central issue for Kyiv's backers. There has been no significant movement toward a ceasefire, and both sides are digging in for another winter of fighting.
news.detailZh: 乌克兰官员称，这场夜间袭击动用了260多架攻击型无人机，是8月一系列创纪录规模空袭的一部分，8月20日基辅另有17人在袭击中丧生。乌克兰以对俄罗斯炼油厂和军事设施的远程打击作为回应，包括逼近莫斯科的无人机袭击。防空系统拦截了大部分来袭武器，但数量过大意味着更多突防，补充拦截弹库存已成为基辅支持者的核心议题。目前没有实现停火的明显迹象，双方都在为又一个冬天的战斗做准备。

businessTips.explanationEn: A pre-mortem is a planning exercise where, before a project starts, the team imagines it has already failed badly and works backward to list every plausible reason why. It was popularized by psychologist Gary Klein as a way to counter overconfidence and groupthink. Because people are giving reasons for a failure presented as certain, they raise concerns they would normally keep quiet. The output is a ranked list of risks plus concrete steps to reduce the biggest ones.
businessTips.explanationZh: 事前验尸法是一种在项目启动前进行的规划练习：团队假设项目已经彻底失败，然后倒推列出所有可能导致失败的原因。该方法由心理学家加里·克莱恩推广，用于对抗过度自信和群体思维。由于失败被设定为「既定事实」，人们会说出平时不愿提的顾虑。最终产出是一份按重要性排序的风险清单，以及针对最大风险的具体应对措施。
businessTips.exampleEn: Before launching a new subscription tier, a product team holds a 30-minute pre-mortem. Someone says the launch failed because existing customers felt the old plan was gutted, which leads the team to grandfather current users. Another says support was overwhelmed by billing questions, so they prepare a help-center article and brief the support team a week early.
businessTips.exampleZh: 在推出新的订阅档位之前，产品团队开了30分钟的事前验尸会。有人说「失败是因为老客户觉得原套餐被掏空了」，于是团队决定让现有用户保留原有权益。另一人说「客服被账单问题淹没」，于是他们提前一周准备了帮助中心文章并对客服团队做了培训。

businessTips.explanationEn: Pre-selling means taking real orders or paid commitments for a product before it fully exists. It is the strongest form of market validation because it measures what people will pay for, not just what they say they like. It also generates early cash flow that can fund development and reduces the risk of building something nobody wants. Common formats include paid pre-orders, founding-member pricing, or a paid pilot with a handful of customers.
businessTips.explanationZh: 预售是指在产品尚未完全成型之前，就获取真实订单或付费承诺。这是最有力的市场验证方式，因为它衡量的是人们愿意为什么付钱，而不仅仅是他们口头上喜欢什么。预售还能带来早期现金流，用于资助开发，并降低做出无人问津产品的风险。常见形式包括付费预订、创始会员价，或与少数客户开展付费试点。
businessTips.exampleEn: A developer planning a niche SaaS tool writes a landing page describing the product and offers annual plans at half price to the first 50 customers, with a promise to refund if it doesn't ship in 90 days. Thirty people pay, covering three months of expenses and confirming the idea is worth building; if only two had paid, the developer would have saved months of work.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一位开发者计划做一款细分领域的SaaS工具，先写了一个落地页描述产品，并向前50名客户提供五折年费，承诺若90天内不能交付则全额退款。有30人付了款，这覆盖了三个月的开支，也确认了这个想法值得做；如果只有两人付款，开发者就省下了几个月的白干。

businessTips.explanationEn: Duration measures how much a bond's or bond fund's price will move when interest rates change, expressed in years. A duration of 7 means that if rates rise by 1 percentage point, the price falls by roughly 7%, and vice versa. Longer-maturity and lower-coupon bonds have higher duration and so swing more. It lets investors compare interest-rate risk across very different bonds with a single number.
businessTips.explanationZh: 久期用「年」来衡量：当利率变动时，一只债券或债券基金的价格会变动多少。久期为7意味着，如果利率上升1个百分点，价格大约下跌7%，反之亦然。到期时间越长、票息越低的债券，久期越高，价格波动也越大。它让投资者用一个数字就能比较各类差异很大的债券的利率风险。
businessTips.exampleEn: With markets pricing in a possible Fed rate hike in September 2026, an investor holding a long-term Treasury fund with a duration of 17 realizes a 0.25-point hike could knock about 4% off its price. They shift part of the position into a short-term bond fund with a duration of 2, which would lose only about 0.5% in the same scenario, trading away some yield for far less price risk.
businessTips.exampleZh: 在市场押注美联储可能于2026年9月加息之际，一位持有久期为17的长期美国国债基金的投资者意识到，加息0.25个百分点可能使其价格下跌约4%。于是他将部分仓位转入久期为2的短期债券基金，同样情形下后者仅下跌约0.5%，用一部分收益率换取大幅降低的价格风险。
